blueprint.summary: Pittsburgh Steelers hold $9.89M in 2026 OverTheCap space ($9.89M effective) and -$11.29M projected for 2027.
blueprint.executiveSummary: Omar Khan and the Steelers front office hold $9.89M in gross 2026 cap space ($9.89M effective), while 2027 currently projects at -$11.29M over an estimated $327M cap ceiling. Rolling unused 2026 cap space 1-for-1 under CBA Article 13 ($4M–$7M target) helps manage scheduled cap escalations for T.J. Watt, Alex Highsmith, Jalen Ramsey, Patrick Queen.

strategicPillars.title: 1. CBA Article 13 Rollover Bridge ($4M–$7M Target vs. -$11.29M 2027 Projection)
strategicPillars.detail: Unused 2026 cap space carries over dollar-for-dollar into 2027, buffering Pittsburgh's projected 2027 ledger without forcing premature void-year restructures.

strategicPillars.title: 2. Prorated Base Salary & Option-Bonus Architecture
strategicPillars.detail: Converting base salary or option bonuses spreads cap charges across up to 5 years (including void years) while preserving weekly in-season flexibility.
